title: Knowledge Check
description: One module's check. Always exactly 5 questions, always a mix of multiple-choice and True/False. The answer, the rationale and the source anchor travel with the question and are rendered into the speaker notes, so a participant copy of the deck carries the questions without the key.

questions.description: Exactly 5. If the module cannot yield 5 real questions it is too thin — merge it into its neighbour at Stage 2 rather than padding here.

stem.description: For true_false, the statement to judge. No negative stems in either type — 'which of these is NOT...' tests reading, not knowledge.

options.description: MCQ only. Distractors must be plausible-but-wrong drawn from the spec itself — the neighbouring status value, the adjacent threshold. Never 'all of the above'.

answer_index.description: MCQ only — the single correct option, zero-based

answer.description: true_false only — whether the statement is true

rationale.description: Why the answer is right, in the words a trainer would use. For a false statement, what the rule actually says.

sources.description: Source-index anchors proving the answer. A question whose answer is not in the documents is not asked, so this is never empty — there is no [GAP] escape hatch for a question.

objective_ids.description: Learning objectives this question tests. Stage 5 checks every objective is tested by at least one question.

cognitive_level.description: Prefer 'apply'. A check made entirely of 'recall' tests whether they read the slide, not whether they can do the task.
